english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone cannot do something.

examples.english: I’m sick today and unable to go to work.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 m4 dak1 faan1 gung1

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is not acceptable.

examples.english: This report is really unacceptable as written.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告寫成咁，真係唔得喎。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 sing4 gam3 zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 wo3
